findings.population: Participants in the included educational/cognitive studies; detailed demographics not extracted
findings.context: Controlled task/training studies with heterogeneous protocols
findings.locator: Research questions; study selection; main-effects/heterogeneity discussion; PMC5576760
findings.design: Meta-analysis of controlled cued versus uncued multimedia studies
findings.exposure: Instructional non-content cues, including highlighting, arrows or spotlighting
findings.measurement: Subjective mental effort, perceived difficulty or their combination
findings.result: Small average reduction in mixed subjective-load ratings, with heterogeneous learning results; exact resource occupancy is not separately isolated.
findings.limitations: Scale/operation heterogeneity and retrospective self-report; not an effect on every load dimension. Numerical meta-regression does not identify mediation.

findings.population: Participants in the included educational/cognitive studies; detailed demographics not extracted
findings.context: Controlled task/training studies with heterogeneous protocols
findings.locator: Abstract results and limitations at canonical/provisional source locator
findings.design: Multilevel meta-analysis of randomized controlled n-back training studies
findings.measurement: Untrained n-back versus other WM, fluid-intelligence and cognitive-control tasks
findings.result: Transfer was substantially task-specific; other-domain/task effects were very small relative to n-back transfer.
findings.limitations: Exact PSY-058 current availability is not directly measured; practice/strategy alternatives and training heterogeneity. No guarantee of broader cognitive capacity.

findings.design: Meta-analysis of controlled pre/post training comparisons
findings.exposure: Heterogeneous working-memory training, not n-back alone
findings.measurement: Verbal and visuospatial WM measures immediately after training
findings.result: Intermediate WM transfer improved immediately after training.
findings.limitations: Broader operation class than candidate n-back; task measures not current available-resource construct. May include Soveri components; no replication sum.

findings.population: Participants in the included educational/cognitive studies; detailed demographics not extracted
findings.context: Controlled task/training studies with heterogeneous protocols
findings.locator: Abstract results and limitations at canonical/provisional source locator
findings.measurement: Nonverbal/verbal ability, decoding, comprehension and arithmetic
findings.result: No convincing reliable far-transfer improvements versus treated controls; changes on WM measures did not explain far-transfer magnitude across studies.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE the exact PSY-058 endpoint but essential transfer boundary. Nondetection not equivalence; no causal pathway from cross-study mediation analysis.

assertions.timing: During/after the specified task or protocol; exact duration and durable transfer unresolved.
assertions.risk: No guaranteed construct change, benefit, legal permission or practitioner eligibility. Proxy and operation heterogeneity; no unmeasured downstream effect or double causal contribution.
assertions.scope: Specified instructional visual cues in multimedia learning; evidence includes varied cue forms and learner populations. Exact occupied-resource measure and cue-specific contrast unresolved.
assertions.measurement: Mental-effort/perceived-difficulty self-reports in current synthesis are not a single normalized PSY-057 measurement.
assertions.mechanism: Cue may guide selection/search and reduce unnecessary processing; mechanism not isolated by cross-study learning correlation.
assertions.rationale: Evidence supports changes in mixed subjective ratings and some learning outcomes, but not a sufficiently aligned exact cue→occupied-resource contrast. UNKNOWN preserves this gap; meta-regression is not mediation.

assertions.timing: During/after the specified task or protocol; exact duration and durable transfer unresolved.
assertions.risk: No guaranteed construct change, benefit, legal permission or practitioner eligibility. Proxy and operation heterogeneity; no unmeasured downstream effect or double causal contribution.
assertions.scope: N-back updating practice in the healthy-adult studies; exact variant, comparator, availability measurement and persistence require further extraction.
assertions.measurement: Practiced/untrained n-back and other WM task scores are proxies, not direct current resource availability.
assertions.mechanism: Practice may improve task-specific strategies/updating operations; general capacity or current resources cannot be inferred from score gain.
assertions.rationale: Task-specific transfer does not establish a causal increase in PSY-058. Preserve supportive intermediate transfer and treated-control far-transfer nondetection as different outcomes; no pooled weights or causal pathway.
